title: Thermal Preview Learning and Lyapunov Safeguarding for Satellite Appendage Vibration Control — reproducibility package

creators.name: Uyulan, Caglar
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering and Architecture, Department of Mechanical Engineering, İzmir Kâtip Çelebi University, İzmir, Türkiye

description: Simulation reproducibility package for thermoelastic moving-reference control with classical LQ preview, neural feedforward compression, nominal Lyapunov filtering and residual strain-rate damping. Major revision includes 320 paired Latin-hypercube cases, paired bootstrap statistics, horizon and component ablations, neural, cubic-polynomial and 256-center RBF surrogates, output-feedback and sensor/delay studies, independent Hermite finite elements, spatial thermal validation, warmed CPU timings and illustrative electrical/wheel accounting. Failed implementations and model limitations are retained. No hardware or flight validation is claimed. Exact optimality applies only to the nominal unconstrained finite-dimensional preview problem.
